neighbours.label: A name ending in 'ari' (Ferrari, Atari, Qat|ari, calam|ari), whether 'ari' is its own piece or the whole name is one token (' Ferrari', ' Atari'); names with other endings (Porsche, Maserati, Sega) and 'safari' (one token) stay quiet.
fire: My uncle restored a vintage Ferrari in his garage.
The museum has an Atari arcade cabinet from 1979.
A Qatari investor bought the football club.
We ordered fried calamari as a starter.
Ferrari unveiled a new hybrid model in Geneva.
Kids queued to play Pong on the Atari.
The Qatari embassy is on the next street.
The fishmonger sells fresh calamari on Fridays.
quiet: My uncle restored a vintage Porsche in his garage.
The museum has a Sega arcade cabinet from 1979.
A Saudi investor bought the football club.
We ordered fried prawns as a starter.
Maserati unveiled a new hybrid model in Geneva.
Kids queued to play Pong on the Nintendo.
The Saudi embassy is on the next street.
The travel agent sells safari trips on Fridays.

notes: Card: 'ari' x18 (Ferr|ari, At|ari), ' Ferrari' x7, ' Atari' x2; word hits 'ari' cov 64%, ' Ferrari' 14%. Tokenizer checked: Q|at|ari, calam|ari split; Ferrari, Atari, safari, Porsche, Sega, Saudi are one token; Maserati is M|aser|ati.
